scope: Single frozen public passage, not full repository

claims.name: Dayton Mall Area Master Plan
claims.description: A master plan for the Dayton Mall Area that aims for catalytic redevelopment, and includes a set of implementation goals and triumphs.

claims.name: Establish stakeholder municipalities, private‑sector partners and advocacy organizations
claims.description: Identify the role of local municipalities, businesses, developers, and advocacy groups to support the plan’s goals.

claims.name: Integrate physical, economic and social investments
claims.description: Prepare a critical mass of support by strategically linking physical improvements, economic growth, and social investments across the mall area.

claims.name: Achieve ten major “triumphs” over 10 years
claims.description: Set specific actions and strategies to complete ten major projects, outlining partners, priority, and timeline.

claims.name: Design and construct new buildings, streets and open spaces
claims.description: Three major triumphs focus on new development: constructing new buildings, redesigning streets, and adding green open spaces that transform the district.
